summary: Adjusts brightness, contrast, opacity, gamma, black level, and related image levels. In feedback loops, opacity on the Post page is the canonical trail decay control.

key_params.name: opacity
key_params.note: Post-page opacity, commonly used as feedback decay

common_gotchas: For feedback trails, decay should usually use opacity, not brightness.
Extreme level changes can make a valid chain look black or clipped; verify luminance/entropy after applying.
